job_text:
Machine Learning Engineer - Lumen AI

About the role
We build models that help doctors review medical images faster. You will take research models and turn them into reliable production services.

Requirements
- Strong Python skills for building ML pipelines
- Experience training models with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals
- Experience deploying models as production services
- Comfortable working with large datasets

Nice to have
- Experience with MLflow for experiment tracking
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
- Exposure to cloud GPUs on AWS or GCP

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- Conference travel budget
